mainEntity.name: How long does ceiling leak repair typically take in Meridian?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of ceiling leak repair in Meridian varies based on the leak's source and the extent of damage. A simple patch after a minor plumbing repair might take a day or two for drying and finishing, while extensive roof repairs or significant water damage requiring mold remediation could take several days or even a week to complete the full restoration. Our team will provide a more accurate timeline after a thorough inspection of your specific situation, factoring in material drying times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a couple of days to over a week, depending on the leak's source, the extent of water damage, and necessary drying times.
